conflicts: Level-table misprints in the archived LAC pages: the even level printed '10 540.750' (J=13/2) is 18 540.750 (confirmed by the 539.203 nm ground-state line); the next out-of-sequence entry '10 733.630' (J=11/2) is probably 18 733.630 and was NOT entered. The odd table repeats the block 30 119 - 34 114 cm^-1 three times; duplicates were dropped.

511.824 nm is printed with the odd level 30 118; the level table has 30 119.865 (J=15/2), which fits the wavelength and is used. The wavelength table classifies 375.008 nm as 0 (J=15/2) - 26 658 (J=17/2), but no even level near 26 658 cm^-1 appears in the level table (neighbours: 26 645.6, 26 691.78, 26 718.477); likewise 1215.905 nm uses an odd level 22 153 (J=7/2) and 359.588 / 361.662 nm an odd level 36 942 (printed '36 942.-78') that could not be read safely. These lines were not entered.
Even levels labelled '5f8.6d.7s' in the table (from 21 506.436 cm^-1) contradict the introduction, which assigns that group to 5f8 6d2 7s; the introduction is followed.

The even level 32 075.25 has J printed as '9-11/2' (entered as '9/2 or 11/2'; the pipeline skips a level without a single J). Several 5f9 7s7p levels carry a parent label 7s7p(3P0) together with a J1j term (15/2,1) or (15/2,2) in the table; labels are copied as printed.
Several lines differ by 3-9 pm between the printed air wavelength and the difference of the tabulated levels (each such line carries a note); the lines are wide hyperfine patterns of 249Bk.
